The pool at the Eye of the World was a well.  Just like one of the charms in Cadsuane's [[Paralis-net]], though it was far more massive.  The well was clean because the taint simply covers the source - and male channelers must reach through it to access [[Saidin]].  But once the power passes to the channeler it is free to use - and if it is stored in a well the power will be clean.
